attacks.name: Shadow Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild| or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: The Hawk's Blades
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: The Cutting Wind
steps: After all attacks generated by this attack are resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the last character targeted by this attack.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild| or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Grappling Hook
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Specter of Death
superPowers.body: When this character targets a character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. During the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may change 1 of its attack dice to a |!hit| for each |!critical| or |!wild| in its attack roll.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
